about: Test targets of the unattended suite (Tools/run_tests.ps1, Editor/TestTargets.cs). Copy this file to Tools/targets.json (a local file, ignored by git) and fill it for your install: visual.female and visual.male each name one clothed, SFW character card of your game's UserData folder (a path relative to that folder, for example chara/female/<card>.png); cards names the two card folders the all-card rows walk; skip lists cards (relative to UserData) that a graphics run must not build. The animation rows are vanilla Studio Anime rows (group, category, no) with their clip name, the expression and look entries are test cases; keep them unless a row asks otherwise. The game root comes from Config/settings.local.json (hs2Root). Without Tools/targets.json the runner reads this file, and the rows whose tests need the cards report WARN 'development input absent: Tools/targets.json' instead of running.
